records.text: Vance, Vance, it's Vance. One day, maybe when you least expect it, you'll start to see those 15 minutes hold more than just grief. The grief is there, always, but so is the beautiful gift of life. And, like I said, you can read this article in its entirety. I was expecting that they would have hired someone who, I don't know, like Nicholas Sparks. Nicholas Sparks is available, right? I haven't—didn't know if he's written a recent book. Notebook was beautiful.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
